question: Can the width- and history-dependent C4E response be explained by the geometry of the exact additive QI storage-error vector relative to the non-QI remainder, together with terminal-layer state-margin scaling, without introducing a new closure or state variable?

C3.role: exact additive teacher-minus-reference local storage decomposition

vector_definition.local_shape_error: mass-neutral theta-shape vector of teacher endpoint minus Reference endpoint
vector_definition.qi_shape_contribution: mass-neutral theta-shape vector induced by the exact C3 QI storage contribution
vector_definition.interpretation: Removing QI improves shape error iff ||qi||^2 + 2 qi dot remainder > 0. It worsens shape error iff this quantity is < 0.

preregistered_metrics: pooled RMS non-QI remainder shape error
mean and median cosine(qi,remainder) on nonzero intervals
fraction intervals for which exact QI removal lowers shape error
fraction intervals for which exact QI removal raises shape error
counterfactual terminal mean-theta margin to theta_r/theta_s
counterfactual reconstructed-interface Se margin where hydraulic_state is admissible
blocked interval count and first blocked step

H_VECTOR_INTERFERENCE.support_rule: For every physically admissible interval, the sign of observed QI-removal shape-error change is exactly predicted by S = ||qi||^2 + 2 qi dot remainder, with squared-norm identity residual <= 1e-12. Case-level improvement fractions must be reproduced without fitted parameters.
H_VECTOR_INTERFERENCE.meaning: C4E width/history reversal is an additive-vector interference effect.

H_TERMINAL_WIDTH_AMPLIFICATION.support_rule: For matched history and route, QI storage-transfer converted to terminal mean-theta perturbation scales inversely with terminal width to numerical identity where storage transfer is the same quantity; admissibility failures must coincide with non-positive state margin under the exact counterfactual, not with mass-ledger failure.
H_TERMINAL_WIDTH_AMPLIFICATION.meaning: Part of the 2.5 cm fragility is geometric state scaling, not evidence for missing mass or a new prognostic state.

adjudication.VECTOR_INTERFERENCE_EXPLAINS_C4E: H_VECTOR_INTERFERENCE supported in all cases; terminal-width evidence may be supportive or mixed.
adjudication.C4E_MECHANISM_PARTIAL: vector identity holds but width/admissibility pattern is not sufficiently explained by the preregistered scaling diagnostics.
adjudication.C4F_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: required predecessor, physical-state reconstruction, or hard identity gate fails.

claim_boundary: No corrected QI closure is authorized.
No extra memory state is authorized.
No application acceptance or speed claim is authorized.
